source: GLM-5.3's MoE cut per expert at its TP8 statics with each weight-row read fused into its GEMM (CIR-187): the router's slots, one output field a slot; each slot's w13 and w2 GEMM blocks MoeExpertFp8ReadGemm(W)_v1, which open the block's rows from a table registered one expert a row (READ = EmbeddingRead_v1{V=256, H=N K/2} at the leaf the router's committed slot index names) and multiply by them inside the one proof block, so no block outputs a weight row; each G-block's scale row read by its own EmbeddingRead_v1 unit and wired in. The router and scale-read strata are the per-expert card's (art:503a55396a39). Units a token are 75 layers x 8 slots on each of 8 ranks; ANDs as circuit-check reports them at those statics (each fused block's are its read's plus its GEMM's); k_log the block Flock's range rule stages each at (benchmarks/one_stage/m1_families.block, which gives every k_log of the per-expert card); output bits from each Definition's outputs (a fused block's N bf16 words and its read's verdict). The fused types are not yet measured by the proof_overhead card, so Figure 1 prices them by their k_log. Definitions built, circuit-checked at every SWAP x DOT tile and tested (in review); the cut is not yet proved or served, and the expert's binding is proved for the read's reference, not yet for its gates.
